title: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series
summary: Rockstar’s long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI is launching November 19th, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X consoles. Rockstar Games has finally given Grand Theft Auto VI a price ahead of the game’s November 19th launch.
